ev.q: is an American animated sitcom created by Bruce W. Smith
one of the few animated kids shows that featured an African-American protagonist
a 14-year-old African-American teenage girl who navigates her adolescence
The series centers on the life of the titular family
warm tale of a family sticking together despite all their frustrations
a mix of positive role models, zany comedy
Smith was inspired to create the series due to the lack of African-American empowerment in animation
premiered as the series finale on August 19, 2005
